title: Apple’s M5 iPad Pro with 1TB of storage drops to its lowest price since summer
content:
Macworld

Apple iPad Pro M5, 11-inch

View Deal

With an M5 processor, OLED display, and 1TB of storage, getting an iPad Pro is almost as good as getting a MacBook, especially if you pair it with a Magic Keyboard. And it’s even better with a cool $300 discount: The 11-inch M5 iPad Pro is on sale at Amazon right now for $1,500, an impressive saving on its $1,799 MSRP and the best price we’ve seen since Apple raised prices this summer.

First and foremost, the iPad Pro is a super thin and powerful tablet that features one of the best screens Apple has ever made, the Ultra Retina XDR display, a similar screen to the one in the new PROLED XDR MacBook Pro. This particular configuration features 1TB of storage, too, so you won’t have to worry about having enough space for apps and games. Performance is where the iPad Pro excels, as the M5 chip handles photo editing, video projects, and a long list of open apps without slowing down.

The chip is also packed with Neural Accelerators and a Neural Engine, which run AI tasks right on the device instead of sending everything to the cloud. Apple Intelligence adds help with everyday writing and organizing. It can rewrite a message so it sounds friendlier, summarize a long email thread, or tidy up your notes. Apple builds it with strong privacy protections, and much of the work happens on the device itself.

On top of being able to use the iPad Pro with a Magic Keyboard to replace your laptop here and there, you can also use the Apple Pencil Pro or Apple Pencil USB-C to sketch and take notes, mixing work with fun. There’s no reason to wait around for Black Friday when this iPad Pro M5 deal is so good, so head over and add it to your cart.
